proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 3655 article gives Malayalam nāl, nālu, nāṅku, nān (before nasals) four; nālar, nālvar, nāluvar four persons; nālām fourth; nālkkāli quadruped; chair; nālkkālikka to creep on all fours; nālpatu forty; nānūṟu 400; nannālu by fours; nannāṅku four times four.. The Byari survey form nālɨ “four” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
